problem_statement: Raw language census is necessary but insufficient.
JSON/Markdown may dominate because receipts, reports and matrices are evidence mass, not source runtime code.
Mechanicus must split source code, evidence, documentation, patch packs and generated outputs.
laws: Raw total is not source-code total.
Evidence mass is not code mass.
Generated/vendor mass must not pollute source cleanliness score.
Source code purity must be scored on source_runtime first.
Governance evidence must be validated by schema/receipt rules, not by code linters.
